def apply_rule(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pc=max((c for c in cnt if c!=bg),key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    blocks=blockify(g,bg,pc)
    assert len(blocks)==2, blocks
    E,B=blocks
    cands=[]
    for dc in range(-W,W):
        agree=0
        for i,r in enumerate(B):
            er=g[E[i]]
            for c in range(W):
                sc=c-dc
                if 0<=sc<W and er[sc]==pc and g[r][c]==pc: agree+=1
        cands.append((agree,dc))
    cands.sort(reverse=True)
    best_dc=cands[0][1]
    o=[list(row) for row in g]
    for i,r in enumerate(B):
        er=g[E[i]]
        for c in range(W):
            sc=c-dc
            if g[r][c]==bg and 0<=sc<W and er[sc]==pc:
                o[r][c]=1
    return o,best_dc,cands[:3]
